name: adb-autolink
description: Zero-touch wireless device control for Claude Code, with a published security review (SECURITY.md). Android: a companion app re-enables wireless debugging on trusted Wi-Fi and the MCP server reconnects on its own, so Claude can install APKs, take screenshots, tap/swipe and read logcat. iPhone (macOS preview): install, launch, stop and screenshot through Xcode's devicectl.
